source: Apple public iTunes Search and Lookup APIs; official App Store page for Lichy
verification: Each included ID was returned by a fresh Apple public API response and lists iPhone support. Names, developers, icons and store URLs come from that response. Summaries describe listing claims, not hands-on testing.
scope: A curated, incomplete index of distinct App Store listings. This is not the number of expense trackers in the App Store. Search rankings, storefront availability and manual selection limit coverage.

discovery.candidateCountMeaning: Raw distinct IDs across broad search responses, including unrelated and unreviewed apps. Not a relevant-app count or store census.
discovery.requestPolicy: Sequential discovery requests with a 3.25-second pause. Stop on API errors; no scraping protection bypass.
discovery.publication: The discovery script only writes unreviewed candidates. Catalog additions require title and description review.

excludes: banking or payment apps without a central expense-tracking use
obvious paid/pro duplicates of an already included product
selection.reviewedPools: Original 45 listings; first 145 US discovery candidates; selected UA/GB discoveries; additional named, travel, budgeting, receipt and shared-expense listings. Not every raw candidate was reviewed.

excludedExamples.name: Daily Tracker Journal & Diary
excludedExamples.reason: General journal rather than a dedicated expense tracker

excludedExamples.name: Money Manager (Remove Ads)
excludedExamples.reason: Paid duplicate of the included Realbyte product

excludedExamples.name: TDF Tracker
excludedExamples.reason: Outside selected personal and business expense-tracker scope

excludedExamples.name: NerdWallet: Smart Money App
excludedExamples.reason: General financial recommendations app rather than a focused tracker

verificationDates.note: Original summaries are retained from the first review; listing identity, developer, icon, URL and iPhone support were refreshed. Record evidence keeps the previous date.
